summary: ACTOOS ONE - QR Code Integration Verification in Partner, Driver, and Admin Dashboards. CODE REVIEW PASSED. All three dashboards (PartnerEarningsScreen, DriverAppScreen, AdminWalletsOverview) correctly import and use PayQRCodeSheet and ScanQRCodeSheet components. These components use REAL QR libraries: qrcode.react (QRCodeSVG) for generating QR codes and html5-qrcode (Html5QrcodeScanner) for camera scanning. Fixed a bug in DriverAppScreen.jsx where loadDriverWallet was called but the function is named fetchDriverWallet.

context_for_next_testing_agent: QR code components are production-ready and integrated in all three dashboards. UI testing was limited because accessing Partner/Driver/Admin dashboards requires specific user roles. The test client user can see 'Devenir Livreur' and 'Devenir Partenaire' buttons but clicking them goes to onboarding flow, not directly to the dashboard. To fully test the QR buttons in UI, need a user with approved driver/partner/admin role.
